# Aseeb Kukku

> Aseeb Kukku (also known as Kukku R11 / Kukkur11, full name Muhammed Aseeb K) is a 24-year-old entrepreneur, serial founder and automotive content creator from Kerala, India. He is the founder of Race Eleven Cars, a used-car showroom in Manjeri, and The Shoepedia, a footwear brand.

## Key facts

- Name: Aseeb Kukku (Muhammed Aseeb K); online as Kukku R11
- Role: Founder of Race Eleven Cars and The Shoepedia; automotive content creator
- Location: Manjeri, Kerala, India
- Race Eleven Cars: used-car showroom offering premium, semi-premium, regular, unique and modified vehicles; second showroom in progress
- The Shoepedia: footwear business with a showroom, website and online presence
- Started in automobiles at age 17 buying and selling Yamaha RX and other two-stroke motorcycles; moved to cars with a Honda City Type 2
- 2018: met his future business partner through an OLX car-accessory listing, which led to Race Eleven
- 2020: custom vehicle modification work expanded into customer projects
- 2023: built a highly customised Honda Civic (flame kit, flip-style trunk, remote-operated features, custom fittings); received Show Stopper recognition at automobile events in Kerala, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu
- Content: automobiles, business, lifestyle and vlogs on Instagram, YouTube and Facebook
